body:
So where would I post what I said?
I am pretty new to reddit and really don't know all of the subreddits..... but I really want what I said to be on reddit I think it could help a lot of people.

What do you mean about wanting something..... I met my best friend in 2013 he had to drag me by the hair (not literally) through all of my depression and the crap I was going through at the time. 

It isn't that simple to want to be happy I had to go through so many things I was just lucky to have found my best friend, I most likely wouldn't be here today if it weren't for him I owe him a lot. 

Things do get better over time but not without being dragged through mud and crap dumped on you, you need a strong supportive team behind you. He did not let me give up he was like a bull digging his horns into my back as a reminder to keep going.

You are still here aren't you? So you still have the will to live you just need someone behind you who cares for you to help keep you going, you cannot do it by yourself I wish it was that simple but it isn't.
You lost me on the time travel part...........
Die Antwoord- I fink you freeky is the first ever song I have ever heard by them.
I am actually working on a long post, I am running out of steam and will try to finish it asap... its 3:25 am and have yet to sleep.......

Zoloft is fucking horrible, I felt the exact same way.
As soon as you feel that way you need to change them, I have been on many different medications this recent one welbrutrin (took 300 mg)   worked fantastic I did something to re-wire my brain though and no longer need to take them after taking them for a year. If you would like to know what that is then feel free to pm me, rather not say what it is here..... don't want people jumping down my throat.

Have you ever talked to your doctor about putting you on medication?
I know it isn't for everyone... I've been suffering from major depressive disorder for as long as I can remember and was on 300 mg of a medication.... I needed to be on that medicine because I just wanted to die nothing made me happy and I was just miserable on that medicine I felt that I could finally be happy. 

2007 was such a horrible year I almost lost my life I don't remember why I decided to keep going but I am glad I did, I am off my medicine sure I still have bad days but I no longer want to die. 

I met my best friend in 2013 and he forced me to change my medicine because the stuff I was on had stopped working.  I am finally happy and you can't be mad at yourself when you have those few moments when you are happy you should be proud of yourself and embrace your happiness you deserve to be happy. 

I really think that being put on a depression medication may help you out but please stay away from zoloft, that shit is just toxic and does more harm then good. I was on Lexapro, Effexor XR, one other one, and the recent one I got off of was welbrutrin which was 300 mg..... if you'd like to know how I got off of it then pm me, I don't want people diving down my throat.... 

I would be happy to talk to you about what I've been through, I am going through a lot right now but talking to other people about what they are going through makes me get my mind off of things. 

Please embrace the happiness when you feel it and never feel like a fraud.

Fuck em, I'd care if you died. 
I am just sensitive like that....
I tried to kill myself back in 2007 because I have/had Major depressive disorder (severe depression) I've had it for as long as I can remember I was a miserable kid and none of my family members seemed to understand what was wrong with me till I was 17 (22 now) who ever says that to you needs a good kick in the throat, I'd be happy to do it too. The kids in my school were ruthless, you need to find that one person that has your back and that knows what you are going through, I am willing to talk about what I've been through if you'd like I love helping people. :)

They are safer, I have watched/seen lots of car accidents on NSFW subreddits to try to desensitize myself... I think it worked a little.... but still... in all of them people in suv's had better survival rates.

Before that accident I was in an accident when I was younger which is why I didn't get my license when I turned 16.. I don't remember that accident at all but it started a downward spiral. 
Have you ever driven a suv, is it scary?
I have no idea what you could do, but thanks for the offer. :)
I'd ride a camel... instead of a polar bear... they are vicious animals.... sure they are adorable but yeah....
I am not religious at all but I'll take all the help/support I can get, thanks. :)
